sources.citation: A US distributor's public ring and fork terminal sheet (read), paraphrased: pre-insulated ring and fork terminals of tin-plated copper with a vinyl sleeve, colour-coded red for 22-18 AWG, blue for 16-14 AWG and yellow for 12-10 AWG (shared across makers; some mark red 22-16); crimp connectors are listed to UL 486A-B (by number). Each colour is crimped in the die nest of the same colour, so this yellow terminal lists the die id "yellow" (the dies of tool.veltmark-cr-2210, F3.4 part 1).
The stud is the screw size the ring fits. A Unified numbered screw size N has a major diameter of 0.060 in + 0.013 in × N (the ASME B1.1 numbering, by number; a definition): #10 is 0.190 in, 4.83 mm.

game-design: 13 mm, rounded from the 0.512 in sleeve dimension the same sheet gives for its yellow terminals; its drawing does not name that dimension, so reading it as the barrel length is an interpretation.
game-design: the terminal takes solid and stranded conductors, as insulated terminals of this class are commonly rated; the sheet read does not say.
